purpose: Canonical RIMBA manufacturing enterprise lifecycle catalogue aligned to the final 12-package domain model and lifecycle code hierarchy.
design_principles: A lifecycle describes the business subject's progression through meaningful states.
A phase is not a workflow; workflows perform work within or between phases.
A workflow may be reused by multiple lifecycle types and phases.
Transitions may include loops, holds, rework, rejection, suspension, reopening, and retirement.
Manufacturing-specific lifecycles are supplemented by enterprise support lifecycles so the catalogue can fit discrete, process, batch, make-to-order, make-to-stock, and mixed-mode manufacturers.
